notes: §1985:XIII.3.10.8 GR2: a control heading or detail ends by 'the line number specified by the LAST DETAIL phrase', a control footing by 'the line number specified by the FOOTING phrase' (also §1985:XIII.3.8.4 GR1 d/e). For 1985 source this holds: with no LAST CONTROL HEADING phrase BindReportDescriptionClauses sets LastControlHeading equal to LAST DETAIL in every default case, GroupLimits gives CH/DE/CF (FD, LCH|LD|FOOTING), ScreenReportGroupLines refuses (COBOL2199) an absolute line past them, and the runtime fit test (PresentBody against LowerLimit) uses the same integers. Probes at 85: CH 13/DE 13 with LD 12 and CF 17 with FOOTING 16 refused; CF at 16 and CH at 12 accepted and printed there; relative CF PLUS 2 printed on line 14 (past LD, within FOOTING) while the next CH PLUS 1 (trial 15 > LD 12) advanced the page; LD omitted gives LD = FOOTING. Missing part: the 2002 LAST CONTROL HEADING phrase is accepted at --std 85 and then sets the CH limit apart from LAST DETAIL. kb/Work PB5242 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-pipe/slice-51.json).

next.reason: 1985: CH and DE lower limit is LAST DETAIL; CF lower limit is FOOTING. 2023 §2023:13.18.57.4 GR8 d) 'The lower limit for a control heading is the line given by the LAST CONTROL HEADING integer', e) DE LAST DETAIL, f) CF FOOTING; §2023:13.18.39.4 GR2 e). The LAST CONTROL HEADING phrase is accepted by 2023 and absent from 1985's PAGE clause, so a CH limit different from LAST DETAIL is a case added; when it is omitted §2023:13.18.39.4 GR3 c) 'integer-5 will be equal to integer-6, if LAST DETAIL is specified', the 1985 value.
